claim_id: Claim identifier CLM-00001..CLM-01500, assigned after shuffling (never encodes the class). Not a feature.
product_id: Product identifier PRD-xxxxx. Not a feature.
product_category: Consumer Electronics | Home Appliances | Industrial Tools (src/core/vocab.py). Feature (one-hot).
fault_category: Fault from the category's covered-fault list. Used by the rule engine (UNCOVERED_FAULT), not a model feature.
fault_description: Free text written from fault + cause, class-independent. Never a feature.
damage_type: Customer-describable cause (7 values, vocab.DAMAGE_TYPES). Feature (one-hot). Not a relabelled class.
warranty_duration_months: Standard term of the category (+12 when extended). Feature.
is_extended_warranty: 1 if an extended term was bought. Feature.
days_to_expiry: Coverage days - age; negative once expired. Feature.
reporting_delay_days: claim date - fault date (0 if negative). Feature.
diagnostic_confidence: Technician's confidence (0-1) that the stated cause is right; 0.5 = not assessed. Feature.
unauthorized_repair_flag: 1 if any earlier repair was by an unauthorised center. Feature.
serial_number_match: 0 if the registered serial differs from the evidence. Feature.
duplicate_invoice_flag: 1 if the invoice/receipt was already used elsewhere. Feature.
claim_date_conflict_flag: 1 if the dates contradict (fault before purchase, etc.). Feature.
missing_document_count: 4 - (receipt + warranty card + damage photo + serial photo). Feature.
scenario: Why the ground-truth policy gave this label (e.g. expired, grace_boundary, covered_defect); '+noise' marks the 4% flipped labels. Never a feature.
claim_class: Target: Valid Claim | Invalid Claim | Manual Review.
